results.description:
MINI App – the essential companion for your MINI.
Check vehicle status, use remote functions, plan trips, manage charging, book a service, and explore MINI features directly from your smartphone.

Get started early with pre-delivery mode as soon as you receive your VIN, and prepare before your MINI arrives.

Check vehicle status
• View your vehicle’s location
• Check fuel or battery level, tyre pressure, and vehicle alerts
• Receive notifications if the alarm is triggered or your vehicle is hit while parked
• Add widgets for faster access

Use remote vehicle controls
• Schedule and start climatisation 
• Lock/unlock doors, access the boot, and operate the horn and lights
• Capture images from inside and outside the vehicle
• Update vehicle settings and onboard apps remotely

Plan trips and navigation
• Plan routes and monitor traffic
• Use the live map for charging, fuelling, and parking information
• Send destinations directly to your vehicle, including from third-party apps
• Review trip history with monthly and yearly summaries

Manage electric charging
• Find charging stations with pricing and nearby amenities
• Use intelligent trip planning to optimise charging stops and estimate costs
• Track charging session history and statistics
• Connect to and control your MINI Wallbox via the app

Explore MINI services
• Discover MINI products, services, and subscriptions
• Watch tutorial videos tailored to your vehicle model
• Link your financial services account for easy access

Manage maintenance and service
• Monitor required services
• Book service appointments in the app
• Chat with your service partner
• Request roadside assistance when needed

The MINI App is optimised for vehicles built from 2018 onwards. Availability of features depends on country, vehicle model, equipment, app version, MINI Connected contract, and service availability. Displayed screens show representative data and may vary depending on vehicle, region, app version, and feature availability.

The MINI Motorer's Guide provides important, model-specific vehicle information on selected MINI models*.

With just one click, you get the knowledge of how to operate the vehicle and its equipment. Explanatory animations, image searches, answers to frequently asked questions and much more complete the app.

By entering the vehicle identification number (VIN), the appropriate model-specific vehicle information is downloaded and is also available offline. You can manage multiple vehicles within the MINI Motorer's Guide. 
If you don’t have a vehicle identification number (VIN) then simply explore the MINI demo vehicle.

The MINI Motorer's Guide at a glance:
• Complete, model-specific Owner’s Handbook, including navigation, communication and entertainment
• Explanatory animations and personalized How-to videos
• Explanation on indicator and warning lights
• Quick links and brief information.
• 360° View: Explore interactively the interior and exterior of your MINI model
• Search by topics
• Search by vehicle pictures to find functions
• Answers to frequently asked questions (FAQ)
• Smart Scan for Apple iPhones: Point your mobile phone camera at an icon in the interior and receive information about the function
• Once downloaded, the MINI Motorer’s Guide can also be used offline

*The MINI Motorer's Guide is available for the following models:
• We support all MINI models starting from 2009

Supplementary information can be found in other brochures in the on-board documentation. 

The more familiar you are with the vehicle, the more confident you are on the road.
MINI wishes you a pleasant and safe driving.

MiniRobot是mini系列智能平衡车配套的手机APP，平衡车与手机通过蓝牙实现智能无线连接。APP中，可以实时查看车辆的各项参数的详细信息，也可以设置某些参数，还支持蓝牙遥控。此APP兼容了大型平衡车M6 Plus和小型平衡车M3型号以及小型平衡车A6型号。兼容的语言有中、英、德、韩、俄罗斯、乌克兰、意大利、西班牙、葡萄牙、阿拉伯、波斯，只需在手机上设置相应的系统语言即可。

Minirobot is a mobile phone app for the mini series intelligent balance car, balance car and mobile phone through bluetooth to achieve intelligent wireless connection. In app, you can view the details of the vehicle's parameters in real time, or set some parameters, and also support bluetooth remote control. This app is compatible with large balance car M6 and small balance car M3 and small balance car A6. Compatible languages include: China, Britain, Germany, Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Arabia, Persia,Czech, just set the corresponding system language on mobile phone.

results.description:
Mini Golf 3D 3 is a free mini golf game that currently includes four 18 hole courses, with a simple to use interface and appealing, custom-modeled holes. Mini Golf 3D 3 now features two player mode (same device) so you can pass and play with a friend. Mini Golf 3D 3 features normal mode, where you can compare your high scores with people around the world and unlock achievements, and a practice mode where you can skip around the course and play any hole you like. There are also 3 different camera modes to cycle through including a behind-the-ball view, aerial view, and another view that gives you a preview of the hole. You can sign in to GameCenter to compete against friends on the global leader boards and earn achievements as well. The leader boards rank the best scores for the current day, week, and all time, as well as the total number of holes-in-one and rounds completed. If you enjoy mini golf, you'll love this relaxing, yet challenging mini golf game. See if you can set the high score and become the mini golf champion!
Tags: Mini Golf, Mini Golf 3D 3, free Mini Golf Game, Minigolf

results.description:
Welcome to your very own Miniverse, where every collectible piece of food, furniture and space is a Make It Mini Moment.

Inspired by the popular MGA’s Miniverse toys and connected by MGA’s Toytap technology, this casual game lets you make your favorite mini items, sort through your inventory, and bring dream spaces to life, taking your Miniverse experience directly into the digital space of this game.

With no timers or stress, this idle game combines interior design, room makeover, and cute collectibles into one relaxing experience. Ideal for fans of meditation-style gameplay, Miniverse enthusiasts, and anyone who loves cute, miniature worldbuilding. 

Interior Design: Create Your Dream Space
Step into a world where every space is a blank canvas and your imagination sets the style. Whether it’s a sweet ice cream shop, a cute pastel bakery, or a colorful diner, your design choices bring these mini spaces to life. Choose wallpapers, arrange furniture and play with color palettes and accessories to reflect your personal style. Inspired by the joy of DIY and tiny room makeovers, this relaxing game lets you transform empty spaces into your dream interior.

Scan & Unlock: Expand Your Miniverse
Bring your real-world mini collection into the game! By scanning official cards from MGA’s Miniverse Make It Mini collectibles, you instantly unlock their matching recipes and ingredients and add them to your in-game Collection Tracker. This means more options during Design Challenges. The more codes you scan, the more themed and rare items you’ll have to boost your rankings in community events. Each scan enhances your design potential, adds depth to your inventory, and rewards real-world collectors with real in-game value. Please note that the NFC card feature is included only on select items distributed only in U.S

Design Challenges: Quick, Creative Fun
From the moment you enter the game, you’ll be greeted with Design Challenges—bite-sized creative prompts that let you express your style in under five minutes. Whether it’s placing mini sundaes into an ice cream shop display case or finishing the countertop design in an Italian pizzeria, every challenge is a chance to showcase your design instincts and make each scene shine. You’ll use your unlocked Recipes and Furniture to meet themed goals and score community points.

The fun doesn’t stop after the intro. New Daily Challenges keep your creativity flowing with fresh scenarios, while Seasonal, Collaborative and Influencer Challenges offer ongoing inspiration and exclusive rewards. Whether you're designing a delicious dessert bar or a ramen stall, every challenge adds to your personal Miniverse story.

Play at Your Own Pace
No timers. No pressure. Just pure relaxation. Designed with busy players in mind, this game invites you to unwind with gentle music, calming visuals and endlessly satisfying interactions. Perfect for playing in short bursts or winding down after a long day, it’s a casual gaming experience that’s both rewarding and relaxing. 

Mini Moments, Big Joy
Feel the satisfying snap of adding the perfect topping to your mini food, placing a tiny table set for two, and customizing a space with themed décor. Inspired by the popularity of unboxing and organizing games, this new experience brings the joy of sorting and assembling into your hands. Each item has a story, and every challenge reveals new surprises.

Mini Worlds Full of Charm
With pastel hues, charming details and irresistibly cute collectibles, this is the ultimate experience for fans of kawaii aesthetics. Everything is designed with love—from mini teapots to tiered cake stands—bringing your Miniverse dreams to life. Channel the charm of your favorite collectible minis with joyful interactions, cute challenges, and small scenes that look good enough to screenshot and share!

Download now and start building your dream Miniverse—where interior design meets decor play and kawaii creativity, all in the palm of your hand.
